llm.summary: This skill is a focused code-review helper that only tells the agent how to inspect diffs and report findings without changing code.

dimensions.detail: Reading diffs, callers, tests, README, and deploy context is proportionate for a code review skill and does not request unrelated local data, credentials, network access, or broad indexing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains a single markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata and no install script, executable file, dependency, or remote payload instruction.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill asks for normal repository inspection needed for review and explicitly says to list findings and change no code.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, tool wrapping, memory writing, scheduled task, background worker, or cross-session behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is code-review quality analysis, and the instructions match that purpose: read the relevant diff and surrounding code, identify concrete issues, and report them.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want stricter code-review reports. It will direct the agent to read relevant repository files and diffs, but it does not instruct the agent to modify files, persist data, use credentials, or run hidden commands.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; direct inspection supports that because the artifact is review guidance only and contains no executable or hidden behavior.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no results; direct inspection found no instruction hijacking, remote execution, embedded malicious code, persistence, or privilege escalation.
